description.en: Peltaspermum-inspired preserved reproductive organ only: thin shallow-wavy peltate disc on a cut curved stalk, with attached simplified basal ovulate structures in a ring on its lower surface. Tilt deliberately reveals the underside relationship. No thick fungal cap, gills, flower, parent plant or separately counted/extracted seed asset; exact count, color and nominal span artistic.
